overview_description.description: CesiumAstro delivers communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space or airborne platforms. Each of the company's products combines carefully selected COTS components with the traditional reliability necessary for aerospace systems. Its products enable connectivity between satellites, drones, planes, cars, and other mobile devices and generate electronically steerable beams of radio waves carrying information between the devices, and its software stitches the information together.

about_short_description.short_description: CesiumAstro provides out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space or airborne platforms.

product.name: Element Fully Integrated LEO Satellite
product.description: A fully integrated low-Earth orbit satellite platform with flexible, software-defined phased array communication payloads for diverse mission types.

product.name: Vireo Multi-Beam Ka-Band Communications Payload
product.description: A multi-beam active phased array system for high-throughput Ka-band satellite communications with dynamic beam and frequency management.

product.name: Skylark Scalable Multi-Beam Communications Payload
product.description: A flat-panel active electronically scanned array terminal providing multi-beam, high-speed connectivity for space, air, and ground platforms.

product.name: Nightingale Steerable Single-Beam Communications Payload
product.description: A plug-and-play single-beam communications system combining a software-defined radio with an ultra-wideband phased array antenna.

product.name: Nightingale Development Kit
product.description: An integrated design kit providing a complete bits-to-RF development solution for Nightingale payload configurations.

product.name: SDR-1001 Software-Defined Radio
product.description: A compact, high-performance software-defined radio designed for operation in low-Earth orbit environments.
